report_information.project_name: AI Code Review & Security Analysis Agent

review_summary.executive_summary: Security analysis found SQL injection and hardcoded passwords.

critical.title: SQL Injection via Query Formatting
critical.description: Dynamic SQL query formatting allows arbitrary query manipulation.
critical.potential_impact: Attacker can bypass auth or dump database records.
critical.suggested_remediation: Use parameterized queries with placeholder binding.

high.title: Hardcoded Database Password
high.category: OWASP A07:2021 - Identification and Authentication Failures
high.description: Database credentials hardcoded directly into source code.
high.potential_impact: Unauthorized database compromise via source repository inspection.

recommendations_for_improvement.reason: Dynamic string concatenation allows unauthorized database access or extraction.
recommendations_for_improvement.suggested_action: Replace query string formatting with bound parameter placeholders (%s, ?).

recommendations_for_improvement.reason: Hardcoded secrets in source control expose accounts to unauthorized compromise.
recommendations_for_improvement.suggested_action: Store credentials in environment variables or an enterprise secrets vault.

final_review_summary: Review concluded with status CHANGES_REQUESTED. The target artifact contains 1 critical and 1 high severity security issues requiring immediate remediation.
